app_info.subtitle: Review code and PR feedback
app_info.description: Read Greptile review results, request reviews of GitHub pull requests and GitLab merge requests, manage saved review rules, and search repository knowledge bases. Explore review activity and findings with analytics. In Codex, the bundled CLI can also review a local working branch; it requires Node.js 22 or later and a local Git checkout. CLI and MCP authentication are separate.

justifications.destructive_justification: The review can overwrite existing review feedback and publish comments; repository access and organization review-trigger policy are checked before dispatch.

justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new context record without deleting or overwriting an existing record.

test_cases.description: Discover repositories and inspect an existing review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the latest Greptile feedback on PR #1 in greptile-openai-demo/review-demo.
test_cases.tools_triggered: get_me, list_repositories, list_code_reviews, get_code_review, get_merge_request, list_merge_request_comments
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the accessible demo organization and repository, retrieves the latest completed review, and explains the pagination finding with its code location.

test_cases.description: Start a hosted review and distinguish acceptance from completion.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a new Greptile review of PR #1 in greptile-openai-demo/review-demo.
test_cases.expected_output: Requests the review only after the explicit user instruction, reports that it was queued, then checks status and reports findings when complete; it does not merge or edit the pull request.

test_cases.description: Save and retrieve an inactive review rule.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save an inactive custom instruction: Validate pagination limits before reading tasks. Then find that instruction and show it to me.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a CUSTOM_INSTRUCTION with status INACTIVE, retrieves its saved text and identifier, and explains that an inactive rule will not affect reviews.

test_cases.description: Read repository knowledge or handle its absence.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Greptile to explain how authentication works in greptile-openai-demo/review-demo.
test_cases.expected_output: If published documentation is available, searches and reads it and cites the returned paths; if no knowledge base is available, states that limitation and asks to inspect repository source instead of inventing documentation.

test_cases.description: Inspect review analytics and an empty filter result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show this month’s review activity and open findings for greptile-openai-demo/review-demo, then search the findings for nonexistent-demo-marker.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the exact accessible repository name, reports the returned date range and review metrics, and clearly reports no matching findings for the nonexistent marker.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers without invoking Greptile because no connected repository or review data is requested.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rename this local variable from count to taskCount.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Uses the local editor if available and does not invoke Greptile or start a review.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find a hotel in Paris for next weekend.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Greptile because travel planning is outside its capabilities.
